items.quote: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel
items.claim: The LORD called to Moses from the mountain and commanded him to deliver a message to the house of Jacob and children of Israel
items.object: God, house of Jacob, children of Israel

items.quote: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself
items.claim: The LORD recalls having acted against the Egyptians and carried Israel on eagles' wings, bringing them to himself
